paper.title: SAGA: A Fast Incremental Gradient Method With Support for Non-Strongly Convex Composite Objectives
paper.selection: Convenience choice, not random sampling; unrelated to PWDFT/DGDFT/ISDF/CDFCI. Used in an older v1/v2 corpus, but neither agent receives any earlier interpretation or score.

conditions.name: with-skill
conditions.skill_body: frozen numerical-paper-reader v3, references loaded on demand

shared_controls.source: identical PDF and extracted full text
shared_controls.length: soft target 2500–4000 Chinese characters plus formulas/tables/pseudocode
shared_controls.code_execution: no paper experiments; parsing the provided PDF allowed
shared_controls.sampling: one generation per condition; no seed control; no reranking or best-of selection

isolation_limits: Fresh task contexts do not remove shared host system rules, tool schemas, skill catalog metadata, pretrained knowledge, or filesystem visibility. No-skill means no skill body/reference loading by instruction. This is not a model finetuning or hermetic sandbox experiment. Agent self-reports are retained, not presented as an independent security audit.
interpretation: A single illustrative pair cannot establish a general improvement, human reading speed, or reproduction success. No score is assigned in this experiment.
publication: Complete agent-authored reports, prompt and setup; source PDF/text and private execution logs are not redistributed.
